items.title: CVE-2026-129496: PHP remote code execution in timezone cache (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A use-after-free bug in the timezone cache of PHP (from the PHP Group), in non-thread-safe builds where a startup warning is written to a file-based error log, lets an attacker crash PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php or CGI workers. Arbitrary code execution may also be possible. The attacker can reach it remotely, without logging in, by sending a crafted request.

items.title: CVE-2026-123890: VMware vCenter authentication bypass in directory service (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. An authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service affects VMware vCenter, as well as VMware Telco Cloud Platform and Telco Cloud Infrastructure. An attacker can exploit it remotely, without logging in, to skip authentication, which could give them full control over the affected systems.

items.title: CVE-2026-114952: MySQL authentication bypass in client programs (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the client programs component of Oracle's MySQL Server and MySQL Cluster lets an attacker read, change, create, or delete critical data that these products can access. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and no action from a user is needed.

items.title: CVE-2025-24983: Microsoft privilege escalation in Win32 kernel subsystem (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The Windows Win32 Kernel Subsystem, a core component of Microsoft Windows, contains a flaw that lets a user with local access gain higher privileges on the affected system. An attacker who already has some authorized access to the machine could exploit this to take greater control than they are permitted.

items.title: CVE-2026-22309
items.summary: The visitor tracking of JTL-Shop automatically registers unknown crawler user agents without filtering the value, and the stored value is rendered without output encoding on several pages of the administration backend (search engine statistics, crawler dashboard widget, crawler edit form, sitemap export download list and campaign details). An unauthenticated remote attacker can store script code with a single request. The code is executed in the browser session of an administrator who opens one of these pages, allowing actions to be performed with the administrator's privileges.

items.title: Sicherheitsvorfall - Einzelhandelsgruppe für Mode
items.summary: Am 16. November 2026 listete die Ransomware-Gruppe Rhysida eine norddeutsche Einzelhandelsgruppe für Mode auf ihrer Leak-Seite. Die Angreifer behaupten, die Server des Unternehmens vollständig kopiert zu haben. Laut den Tätern wurden 384 GB Daten in 673.267 Dateien exfiltriert. Darunter sollen sich die Buchhaltungsdatenbank, Dokumentenarchive, E-Mails und die Lohnbuchhaltungsinfrastruktur befinden. Zudem seien Ausweisdokumente der Inhaber, Informationen zu privaten Geldeinlagen und Passwörter im Klartext für Bank-, PayPal- und Händlerkonten kompromittiert worden. » Details

items.title: CVE-2026-115560: PHP remote code execution in session serializer
items.summary: PHP has a flaw where session upload progress data, when enabled, can be read back with a mismatched session serializer, letting an attacker inject objects into the application. A remote attacker who can submit a multipart upload, without logging in, could use this to run code if the application contains a suitable gadget chain, or to corrupt sessions or cause a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-126714: PHP remote code execution in session file handling
items.summary: PHP's default file-based session handler can leave a session file with a mix of new and old data if a write is interrupted, so an attacker who can influence session data may inject objects and, if the application contains a suitable gadget chain, run code on the server. The attacker can reach this remotely without logging in, though the attack depends on interrupting a write at the right moment.

items.title: CVE-2026-129289: PHP remote code execution via unread request bodies
items.summary: PHP (PHP-FPM) can mishandle an unread HTTP request body when an application opens php://input without reading it fully. In setups where the web server reuses backend connections, which is not the default in nginx or Apache, a remote attacker with no login can send one crafted multipart request to forge a backend request and potentially run attacker-controlled PHP code.

items.summary: SOAP use-after-free when processing DTD entity references. The SOAP extension frees the document type definition (DTD) of a parsed XML document while attribute values can still refer to entities it owns, and can then read freed memory. Removing the DTD also bypasses the SOAP server's rejection of documents that contain one. items.title: CVE-2026-123058
items.summary: The web installer of JTL-Shop executes its state-changing installation tasks without checking whether the shop is already installed, and was not removed or locked after the installation. An unauthenticated remote attacker who can reach the installer directory can supply their own database credentials, create administrator and synchronisation accounts and overwrite the shop configuration. This can lead to a full takeover of the shop, including code execution on the server.

items.title: CVE-2026-22311
items.summary: The failed-login limiter of the JTL-Wawi synchronisation interface of JTL-Shop derives the client identity from the client-controlled X-Forwarded-For header and counts requests without credentials as failed logins. An unauthenticated remote attacker can block the synchronisation between JTL-Shop and JTL-Wawi with a few requests and repeat this indefinitely, so that orders are no longer handed over to JTL-Wawi. No data is disclosed and no code is executed.

items.title: Authenticating IoT Data on Ethereum after Pectra and Fusaka: A Cost Study of Signature Schemes, Batching and Anchoring for Agricultural Supply Chain Finance
items.summary: arXiv:2611.23764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Blockchain-based supply chain finance can turn the sensor-recorded production history of smallholder farms into verifiable credit evidence, but only if every record is authenticated and anchored at a cost that scales to large device fleets. items.title: CVE-2026-133430
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. This vulnerability allows an authenticated remote attacker to cause a denial of service by terminating active sessions of arbitrary users. When processing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) documents that lack a root signature, Keycloak accepts the request as long as any assertion within the document is signed, without verifying its context or placement. An attacker holding a validly signed assertion can embed it into an unsigned logout request for another user, causing Keycloak to accept the forged request and terminate the victim's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-121481: OpenSSL heap buffer overflow in EVP_EncodeBlock() output sizing (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Calling EVP_EncodeBlock() in OpenSSL with an input length close to INT_MAX can overflow the calculation of the encoded output size. This causes writes past the end of the caller-supplied output buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-107494: OpenSSL denial of service in QUIC connection ID frames (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. OpenSSL's QUIC stack has a flaw where it queues a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame for retransmitted NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames as well. A remote malicious QUIC peer could use this to queue an unlimited number of those frames.

items.title: CVE-2026-95643: Zoho DDI Central authenticated command injection in Telnet connectivity (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Zohocorp ManageEngine DDI Central is affected by an authenticated PowerShell command injection flaw in its Telnet connectivity feature. An attacker who can reach the product over the network and log in with high privileges can use specially crafted IPv6 scope identifiers to run arbitrary commands on managed Windows nodes.

items.title: CVE-2026-95645: Zoho DDI Central authenticated command injection in clear_blocked_domains (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Zohocorp ManageEngine DDI Central builds before the fixed release contain an authenticated command injection flaw in the Windows DDI Agent's clear_blocked_domains function. An attacker with high-privilege login credentials can reach it over the network and use specially crafted blocked-domain values to run arbitrary commands on Windows systems.

items.title: CVE-2026-129182: PHP memory corruption via stale last_fatal_error_backtrace
items.summary: A use-after-free flaw in PHP (from the PHP Group) lets an attacker corrupt memory, crash PHP-FPM or mod_php workers, and possibly run their own code. It can be reached remotely without logging in, but only on servers with specific per-path or per-directory configuration, where a fatal error during request shutdown leaves stale data that a later request on the same worker then uses.

items.title: CVE-2026-129481: PHP memory corruption in session shutdown cleanup
items.summary: PHP's session extension has a use-after-free flaw: if a fatal error occurs in an application callback during session shutdown, a stale pointer to the script filename can later be freed by another request handled by the same worker. An attacker who can trigger such a failing cleanup could crash the worker or corrupt memory, reaching it remotely without logging in, though it only applies when the...

items.title: CVE-2026-99306: Linux kernel out-of-bounds read in Ceph MDS map handling (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Linux kernel's Ceph filesystem client can read past the end of a stack buffer when handling a metadata server map from a monitor. An attacker who can send a crafted map claiming more ranks than the buffer holds could cause a memory-safety fault in the kernel.

items.title: CVE-2026-99304: Linux kernel out-of-bounds read in Ceph snap trace bounds check (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Linux kernel's Ceph filesystem client has an integer overflow in its snapshot trace bounds check. A malicious or compromised metadata server can send a crafted snapshot message that makes the kernel read memory past the end of the received message buffer. No action by the client is needed, since the read can happen when the client processes an unsolicited snapshot message, an MDS reply, or ...

items.title: CVE-2026-99310: Linux kernel use-after-free in NFSD open owner tracking (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A flaw in the Linux kernel's NFS server (nfsd) can cause a use-after-free memory error when it handles a client identification request with mismatched credentials at the same time as another request is freeing client state. An attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in, which could let them take control of the system or crash it.

items.title: CVE-2017-7577: Arbitrary file read via directory traversal in HTTP server (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. XiongMai uc-httpd has a directory traversal flaw that lets an attacker read arbitrary files on the system. An attacker can exploit it remotely, without logging in, by sending a crafted "GET ../" HTTP request.

items.title: CVE-2014-0780: InduSoft Web Studio admin password disclosure via path traversal in web server (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. InduSoft Web Studio, an industrial automation and HMI development software, is affected by this vulnerability. A remote attacker can send specially crafted web requests to read administrative passwords stored in application files, which could then be used to run arbitrary code on the system.

items.title: CVE-2026-61827

items.title: CVE-2026-131298
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with edit permission on a workbook could configure a service-level agreement at only the workbook phase or task level. Splunk SOAR then flags the task as overdue immediately and does not display the configured deadline in the work queue. The incorrect deadline status could obscure genuine deadline breaches. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR treats an absent phase-level or task-level service-level agreement as immediately due when it compares the configured due times. For more information see Define tasks using workbooks…

items.title: CVE-2026-131296
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with permission to author and run playbooks could add messages to a different playbook run log and cause that run to fail, including runs outside the labels that the user could access. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not verify that playbook API requests use the trusted runtime context for the current playbook run.

items.title: CVE-2026-131295
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to create and run playbooks could start child playbooks on containers outside the authorized label, or repository scope for that user. This could expose container data and affect automation outside that scope. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not bind the identity used to authorize the child playbook run to the parent playbook execution context.

items.title: CVE-2026-131294
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user who can edit and run playbooks on a container label could associate a custom-function callback with another playbook run. The callback could modify the state of a container outside the authorized scope for that user. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not bind playbook API requests to the trusted playbook run and container context.

items.title: CVE-2026-131293
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to edit and run playbooks could read or overwrite persisted data for playbook runs outside the authorized label, or ownership scope for that user. The affected data can include playbook inputs, prompt and block results, outputs, and secrets that playbooks save in run data. Overwriting the data could corrupt results that paused, scheduled, or parent playbook runs later use. The vulnerability is possible because the playbook automation APIs do not bind data operations to the active playbook run.

items.title: CVE-2026-133201
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in smartalock wireguard-lwip up to cfba91666590e86bd67842c71cedf9a423be823a. Impacted is the function mul of the file src/crypto/refc/x25519.c of the component X25519 Ladder. Executing a manipulation can lead to out-of-bounds write. The attack can be executed remotely. This product implements a rolling release for ongoing delivery, which means version information for affected or updated releases is unavailable. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-131291
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a Splunk SOAR user who can edit and run playbooks for a permitted container label could associate action and callback state with a running playbook outside that container label. This could affect playbook automation for containers that the user cannot view. The vulnerability is possible because the Playbook Automation API accepts a supplied playbook run identifier without verifying that it is bound to the server-provided playbook execution context. The vulnerability requires a running playbook on a container label that the user cannot view.

items.title: CVE-2026-131290
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to edit and run playbooks could view child playbook status and loop-state metadata for playbook runs outside the authorized scope for that user. The vulnerability is possible because the playbook status API does not bind the requested run to the current execution context before it returns metadata.

items.title: CVE-2026-131289
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user who holds a role that can edit and run playbooks in Splunk SOAR could cause Splunk SOAR to run non-read-only actions from a Safe Mode playbook, resulting in unauthorized state changes. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not verify that the playbook run context in an action request matches the context that the server provided.

items.title: CVE-2026-131288
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with access to the configured load balancer account could replace a load balancer helper that Splunk SOAR later runs with root privileges during cluster lifecycle operations. If a Splunk SOAR administrator performs a cluster lifecycle operation, Splunk SOAR could execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the load balancer. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not verify the integrity or ownership of the load balancer helper before running it with root privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-131286
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to author and run playbooks could view action data outside the authorized scope for that user and change the status and message of another playbook run. The vulnerability is possible because the playbook API does not verify that the requested playbook run is within the authorized scope of the authenticated user.

items.title: CVE-2026-131285
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user who can edit and run playbooks could cause automation batches for other events to stop running. The vulnerability occurs because Splunk SOAR does not bind playbook API requests to the server-provided execution context.

items.title: CVE-2026-131284
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to view and edit containers could import a container archive that makes artifacts appear to be part of a case or have notes when no corresponding case associations or notes exist. This could cause Representational State Transfer (REST) API clients and filters to use incorrect artifact state. The vulnerability is possible because container archive import accepts artifact workflow state from the archive instead of deriving that state from associated cases and notes. items.title: CVE-2026-131283
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with playbook edit permission could cause later playbook conversions to include spurious branch conditions. This can prevent downstream blocks from running in affected converted playbooks. The vulnerability is possible because the playbook converter retains branch conditions from previous conversions.

items.title: CVE-2026-131282
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user who holds the "Observer" Splunk SOAR role could access a password-reset credential in a diagnostic log bundle and reset the password for an active local account. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not redact password-reset email bodies before it logs communications between product processes.

items.title: CVE-2026-131281
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with asset edit permission could change the approval requirements and effective automation user for an asset without Splunk SOAR recording field-level audit details for those changes. This could weaken investigation and accountability for changes to security-sensitive asset settings. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not include the asset approval voting fields and effective automation user field in its field-level audit coverage.

items.title: CVE-2026-131279
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to edit artifacts could cause indicator correlation data to retain stale field associations, which can produce incorrect correlation results and event counts. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR does not remove stale indicator associations when an artifact changes.

items.title: CVE-2026-131278

The vulnerability is possible because App Editor debug actions expose sensitive runtime information to other local users on the affected host.

items.title: CVE-2026-131272

items.title: CVE-2026-131269
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the Apps edit permission could cause Splunk SOAR to execute arbitrary code on the host when the user validates an installed app. The vulnerability is possible because the app validation workflow does not isolate untrusted code from the trusted environment.

items.title: CVE-2026-131268

items.title: CVE-2026-131266

items.title: CVE-2026-131265
items.summary: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings view permission but not the Assets view permission could view asset names, asset identifiers, app names, tenant names, and ingestion schedule settings for polling assets in the ingestion schedule view. items.title: CVE-2026-131264

Depending on the configuration, the exposed credential could include an access token, application secret, account password, or client certificate. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR reuses the stored credential when the user changes the external credential store endpoint without supplying replacement credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-125288

We recommend customers promptly apply appropriate updates or upgrade to a patched release if they have not already done so.

items.title: CVE-2026-99332

This will avoid calculating (1 << n) when n is 32, which was the cause of the invalid shift.

items.title: CVE-2026-133245
items.summary: parse5 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains an uncaught exception vulnerability in Preprocessor#_processSurrogate that allows remote attackers to crash applications by supplying two consecutive low surrogates. Attackers can submit input such as U+DC00 U+DC00, which decodes to out-of-range code point 0x110000 and throws a RangeError from parse, parseFragment, or streaming parsers, crashing Node.js processes.

items.title: CVE-2026-133244
items.summary: parse5-html-rewriting-stream 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in RewritingStream#emitText, which skips escaping based on a stale lastStartTagName. Attackers can place entity-encoded markup after a closed script or style element to bypass RewritingStream-based filters and execute script in users' browsers.

items.title: CVE-2026-133242
items.summary: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject script by crafting og:video:secure_url values. Attackers can post links to pages whose allowlisted-prefix video URL contains a quote and onload handler, executing script in readers' sessions when they click the video preview.

items.title: CVE-2026-133240
items.summary: OpnForm before 2.8.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in PublicWebhookUrl::isPublicIp that fails to reject CGNAT, NAT64 and 6to4 address ranges. Authenticated users can configure webhook, form import or PDF image URLs resolving to these ranges to make the server send HTTPS requests to internal hosts.

items.title: CVE-2026-133238
items.summary: SABnzbd through 5.1.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the Sorter that allows attackers to write files outside the Complete folder via crafted propername, episodename or job name (%dn) values. Attackers can supply a malicious NZB with '...' sequences that collapse to '..' after single-pass replacement, moving downloaded files into arbitrary directories writable by SABnzbd.

items.title: CVE-2026-133236
items.summary: Modoboa before 2.13.0 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability that allows Resellers or users with domain add or change permission to inject rspamd DKIM selector map entries by supplying an unvalidated dkim_key_selector through the relay domain API. Attackers can embed a carriage return in the selector to override another tenant's domain selector, causing rspamd to sign its outgoing mail with a nonexistent selector and fail DKIM verification.

items.title: CVE-2026-133235
items.summary: Tandoor Recipes before 2.7.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows space admins to reach internal hosts because Nextcloud.get_client builds WebDAV clients from Storage.url without calling safe_request. Attackers can create a NEXTCLOUD storage via POST /api/storage/ pointing at internal hosts, import a file, then call GET /api/get_recipe_file// to read internal service or cloud metadata responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-133233
items.summary: Quasar before 2.35.3 contains a DOM clobbering vulnerability that allows attackers to break native wrapper detection by injecting HTML elements named Capacitor, cordova, or StatusBar. Attackers can place markup such as a div with id Capacitor into server-rendered or pre-rendered HTML so app.use(Quasar) throws and the application never mounts, or openURL() and AddressbarColor.set() throw.

Attackers can supply an image lacking a superblock entry or recording block_count 0, causing lfs->seed % lfs->block_count to trigger SIGFPE and denial of service.

The captureRemote mechanism previously stored only a boolean flag indicating whether the link was internal, and the authorization check in captureSGExisting relied solely on that flag. For non-internal pulls and feeds, the check was insufficient:…

items.title: CVE-2026-133174
items.summary: HotGo 2.18.6 through 2.19.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated backend users to read other administrators' private letters because the messageIds helper omits the receiver filter. Low-privilege users can call GET /admin/notice/pullMessages, which is exempt from role permission checks via exceptAuth, to retrieve titles, contents and senders of private letters.

items.title: CVE-2026-133171
items.summary: Tiptap @tiptap/core 3.7.0 before 3.30.5 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in parseAttributes and parseShortcodeAttributes that allows attackers to exhaust CPU through quadratic backtracking. Attackers can supply Markdown with long crafted attribute strings parsed by createBlockMarkdownSpec, createAtomBlockMarkdownSpec or createInlineMarkdownSpec to stall browser pages or server processes.

items.title: CVE-2026-133170
items.summary: Tiptap @tiptap/core 2.0.0-alpha.0 before 3.30.4 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject DOM attributes via a __proto__ key passed to mergeAttributes(). Attackers can supply untrusted JSON attribute data whose __proto__ replaces the merged object's prototype, causing DOMSerializer.renderSpec to render injected event handlers that execute JavaScript.

items.title: CVE-2026-99406
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: fix lost errno returned from xfarray_foliosort LOLLM noticed that we stop the sort early but don't actually pass along the error code, which could enable repair code to continue running with an unsorted array. Fix that.

items.title: CVE-2026-99405
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: abort dirtree repair if the live update hook dies LOLLM notices that if the live update hook for the directory tree repair code hits an error, it will set dl->aborted and stops working. If the repair code ever sees that condition, it ought to bail out immediately instead of continuing with obsolete data.

items.title: CVE-2026-99404
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: check fork type against dabtree block magic number LOLLM complains that we fail to flag dabtree blocks that should never be associated with the file fork -- data forks can't point to xattr leaves, and attr forks can't point to dirent blocks. Add the missing checks.

items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: mark overfull dabtree node blocks as corrupt LOLLM observes that we need to range-check the dabtree node record count before using it to index an array. Fix that.

items.title: CVE-2026-99402
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: netfilter: nft_payload: restrict checksum offsets to known values We need to prevent userspace from corrupting e.g. tcp->doff, because many locations in conntrack and conntrack helpers rely on nf_conntrack_in() having validated the packet headers. nft_payload allows to alter headers later which invalidates this assumption. The 'Fixes' commit restricts writes to safe fields, but there is another side channel: the checksum location. Restrict this too. Reported via sashiko/gemini.

items.title: CVE-2026-133074
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient authorization checks in the quiz overrides web service allow an authenticated user with teacher privileges to modify user and group overrides for quizzes they do not have permission to manage. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to improperly alter exam access, deadlines, or testing conditions across unauthorized courses.

items.title: CVE-2026-133073
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's single view grade report web service. A missing authorization check allows authenticated students to view the names of all grade items in a course, including those configured to be hidden. This vulnerability leads to unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133068
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. An improper authorization check when displaying individual glossary entries allows an authenticated user to view approved glossary items from courses they do not have permission to access. This vulnerability leads to unauthorized information disclosure of restricted educational materials.

items.title: CVE-2026-133067
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to missing ownership checks in badge alignments, an authenticated user with badge management privileges can view and modify alignments associated with badges they do not own. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized data disclosure and tampering with badge configurations.

items.title: CVE-2026-133060
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's Blackboard question import format. Insufficient validation of file paths during the question import process allows an authenticated user with permissions to import questions into a question bank to read arbitrary files accessible to the web server process. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to view sensitive files, resulting in unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133059
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. The grade feedback web service does not properly verify group and course enrolment permissions. An authenticated user with non-editing teacher privileges can exploit this vulnerability to access grade feedback and user profile details across groups or courses they are not authorized to view, leading to unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-129927
items.summary: A credential-handling weakness in the MongoDB Python Driver allows a configuration option value that protects private key material to be written in clear text into the embedding application's own output and log records when a driver object is converted to text. A party able to read that output may obtain the credential. Obtaining it requires read access to the application's local output or log files.

items.title: CVE-2026-129926
items.summary: The MongoDB Python Driver does not neutralize NUL characters in the user name and password values it places into the message it builds for SASL PLAIN authentication. A party who can choose the login values that an application passes to the driver can alter where the fields of that message begin and end. This may result in a receiving system reading a login name and secret that differ from the values the application supplied. Authenticating as a different account still requires that account's password. Only deployments that use SASL PLAIN authentication are affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-129925
items.summary: The MongoDB Ruby Driver does not neutralize NUL characters in the user name and password values it places into the message it builds for SASL PLAIN authentication. A party who can choose the login values that an application passes to the driver can alter where the fields of that message begin and end. This may result in a receiving system reading a login name and secret that differ from the values the application supplied. Authenticating as a different account still requires that account's password. Only deployments that use SASL PLAIN authentication are affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-129924
items.summary: The MongoDB Ruby driver can include unmasked connection string content in the error it raises when a connection string cannot be parsed. If that connection string carries a secret, the secret may be disclosed in cleartext through the application's error output or logs. No privileges on the driver and no network access are needed to produce the error; a party able to read the application's error output may obtain the secret.

items.title: CVE-2026-133114
items.summary: Caddy – WooCommerce Side Cart & Free Shipping Bar plugin for WordPress 3.0.0 before 3.2.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the saved-items/add REST endpoint that exposes non-public product data. Authenticated attackers with Subscriber-level access can enumerate product_id values to read names, prices, images and stock status of private, draft, hidden and password-protected products.

items.title: CVE-2026-99413
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: fix buffer overruns in xfs_ioc_attr_list When we converted the al_offset array in struct xfs_attrlist into a VLA, the size of the object shrank by 4 bytes. Unfortunately, the buffer size validation in the attrlist ioctl wasn't updated to notice this, so the al_offset[0] assignment blindly writes off the end of the buffer. LOLLM noticed the omitted check and complained.

items.title: CVE-2026-99411
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: actually lock the metafile reservation when adjusting after repair LOLLM reported that xrep_reset_metafile_resv performs unlocked loads and stores to the metadata file space reservation counters and thus can race with other threads. Fix this by taking the lock.

items.title: CVE-2026-99410
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: always reset incore attr fork buffer when resetting fork LOLLM noticed that the local format attr fork verifier depends on if_bytes being set correctly. However, the fork reset function doesn't reset that correctly, which can cause post-repair verifier failures. Fix that.

items.title: CVE-2026-99409
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: don't fix the directory tree if live update fails LOLLM complains that we don't double-check dl->aborted one last time to before committing repairs to the filesystem. This is important because the live update handler could have set ->aborted if it encountered a runtime error.

items.title: CVE-2026-99408
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: don't proceed with xattr repair if the live update fails LOLLM observes that we ought to make one last check for failed live updates before replacing the xattr structure. Let's be cautious here.

items.title: CVE-2026-99407
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: don't repair fs summary counters with garbage LOLLM noticed that if we scan the filesystem and come up with totally garbage numbers for the summary counters, we don't actually mark the scan incomplete. Because we don't do this, repair can install the garbage values into the filesystem, making things worse. Don't do that.

items.title: CVE-2026-129939
items.summary: The MongoDB C Driver places a submitted connection-string option value into a diagnostic message without redaction when that option fails validation. The message is returned to the calling application and is also written to the process's standard error by the driver's default logging behavior. A party that can influence the connection string given to an application using the driver may cause that field's contents to be recorded, which may result in unintended disclosure of information the application placed in that field.

items.title: CVE-2026-129929
items.summary: The MongoDB Node.js Driver does not neutralize NUL characters in the user name and password values it places into the message it builds for SASL PLAIN authentication. A party who can choose the login values that an application passes to the driver can alter where the fields of that message begin and end. This may result in a receiving system reading a login name and secret that differ from the values the application supplied. Authenticating as a different account still requires that account's password. Only deployments that use SASL PLAIN authentication are affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-129928
items.summary: The MongoDB PHP extension includes the full connection string it was given in the error it raises when that string cannot be parsed. A party able to influence any part of the connection string, including a part that holds no secret, can cause the resulting message to carry credentials into the application's standard error output and log files. This may result in unintended disclosure of authentication material to anyone able to read that output.

items.title: CVE-2026-133075
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to insufficient authorization checks in the quiz random question filter web service, an authenticated user with teacher privileges can modify random question settings in quizzes they do not have permission to manage. This flaw allows unauthorized users to alter assessment configurations across courses they do not oversee.

items.title: CVE-2026-133072
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient authorization checks in the quiz editing functionality allow an authenticated user with teacher privileges to view slot details and modify sections of quizzes they do not have permission to manage. An attacker could exploit this flaw to alter quiz configurations or disclose quiz structure information without proper authorization.

items.title: CVE-2026-133071
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to a missing authorization check when editing Lesson activity pages, authenticated users with teacher privileges can view and move lesson pages from courses they are not permitted to access into their own lessons. This issue can lead to unauthorized access and modification of restricted course content.

items.title: CVE-2026-133070
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to a missing authorization check when viewing and restoring wiki page versions, an authenticated user can access content from courses they are not permitted to view. This issue allows an attacker to inspect restricted course material and copy it into their own wiki pages, leading to unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133069
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Missing authorization checks in the forum discussion web services allow authenticated users to view discussion information in courses they do not have permission to access. In addition, users with teacher privileges may lock forum discussions in courses where they lack proper authorization. This issue can lead to unauthorized information disclosure and unauthorized discussion state modification.

items.title: CVE-2026-133066
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Missing ownership verification in Feedback activity templates allows an authenticated teacher to view, use, or delete templates associated with courses other than their own. This can result in unauthorized access, modification, or deletion of course materials.

items.title: CVE-2026-133065
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to insufficient permission checks and input validation in the quiz question bank callback, an authenticated user can access and view questions from question banks they do not have permission to access. Furthermore, this issue allows users to trigger arbitrary class instantiation (creating unintended application objects), potentially leading to further unauthorized actions.

items.title: CVE-2026-133064
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient sanitization of objective identifiers in the SCORM (Sharable Content Object Reference Model) objectives report allows an authenticated user with content upload permissions to inject malicious scripts. When another user views the report, the injected script executes in their browser session, potentially allowing the attacker to access sensitive information or perform unauthorized actions on their behalf.

items.title: CVE-2026-133063
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to insufficient validation when saving activity settings, an authenticated user with teacher privileges can modify activities in courses they are not authorized to access. This flaw allows unauthorized changes to course materials, compromising the integrity of course content.

items.title: CVE-2026-133062
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's external database enrolment plugin. Insufficient sanitization of data passed to queries against the external database allows an authenticated user with course editing permissions to perform a Structured Query Language (SQL) injection attack. When this non-default plugin is enabled, an attacker can exploit this issue to view, modify, or delete sensitive records within the connected external database.

items.title: CVE-2026-133061
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to a missing capability check in the grade items web service, an authenticated user with a student role can view the names of all grade items in a course, including those intended to be hidden. This flaw leads to unauthorized information disclosure of hidden course assessment details.
